description: Calculate the video file size from a target bitrate and duration, or the required bitrate to hit a target file size, with an optional separate audio bitrate. Pure arithmetic (file size bytes = total bitrate bits/sec * duration seconds / 8); no container parsing or encoding is performed.

durationSeconds.description: Video duration in seconds (must be positive)

mode.description: size-from-bitrate requires videoBitrateKbps; bitrate-from-size requires targetSizeMB

targetSizeMB.description: Required for mode "bitrate-from-size"; decimal MB (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes)

name: calculate_video_bitrate
